chapters.title: The 1% Chance of Survival
chapters.goal: Survive the initial transition by exploiting a 100% crit-rate bug on a tutorial boss.
chapters.stakes_shift: From certain death to possessing an unintended mechanical advantage.

bridge.from_prev: Protagonist dies in the real world due to a freak statistical anomaly.
bridge.to_next: The protagonist enters the first hub city with a bag full of 'impossible' tutorial loot.

chapters.title: Looting the Narrative
chapters.goal: Identify the 'Speed-to-Crit' conversion exploit while navigating the starter city's bureaucracy.
chapters.stakes_shift: From lucky survivor to deliberate exploiter of system physics.

bridge.from_prev: Arriving at the hub with high-tier loot and suspicious stats.
bridge.to_next: The protagonist joins a low-stakes dungeon crawl to test his 'Hit & Run' theory.

chapters.title: The Glass Cannon Special
chapters.goal: Clear the Sunken Crypt dungeon using a zero-hit strategy that breaks the local leaderboard.
chapters.stakes_shift: From an unknown player to a target of interest for the 'System Integrity' guild.

bridge.from_prev: Entering the dungeon with a build that shouldn't work.
bridge.to_next: The local authorities realize the protagonist is bypassing standard combat cooldowns.

chapters.title: Grand Theft Artifact
chapters.goal: Infiltrate the high-security 'Admin Vault' to steal a Luck-Stabilizer before the System patches his exploit.
chapters.stakes_shift: From a high-performing player to a wanted 'glitch' in the world's eyes.

bridge.from_prev: The realization that a server-side update will soon nerf his crit-build.
bridge.to_next: The protagonist is forced to flee the city as a bounty is placed on his 'illegal' stats.

chapters.title: Aggro Management for Dummies
chapters.goal: Evade a relentless System Corrector by manipulating mob pathing and aggro ranges in the Dead-Zone.
chapters.stakes_shift: From fleeing the system to learning how to rewrite its pursuit logic.

bridge.from_prev: Escaping the city with a stolen artifact and a world-wide bounty.
bridge.to_next: The protagonist discovers the source code of the Corrector's AI.

chapters.title: The Zero-Percent Solution
chapters.goal: Defeat the System Corrector in a final confrontation by forcing a mathematical overflow error.
chapters.stakes_shift: From being hunted by the system to becoming a permanent, unpatchable exception.

bridge.from_prev: Luring the Corrector into a zone where the physics engine is unstable.
bridge.to_next: The defeat of the Corrector causes a localized reality shift.

chapters.title: Running the Numbers
chapters.goal: Establish a base of operations in the 'Glitch Zone' where the protagonist can dictate the rules.
chapters.stakes_shift: From a frantic fugitive to the master of a new, exploited reality.

bridge.from_prev: Surviving the system's attempt to delete his character.
bridge.to_next: The protagonist prepares for the next 'Update' with a team of fellow outliers.
